newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in brisker trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in brisker trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in much brisker trade on Tuesday, with fully listed issues among top gainers.
* Of seven active issues four rose and three fell.
* Turnover higher at 15 million kuna, volume 17,578.
* Biggest gainer Zagrebacka Banka E-series rose 70 kuna to 430, on volume of 743 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Jadranturist, lost 45 kuna to 220, with 60 shares sold.
* Most actively traded was Zagrebacka Banka, which gained 35 kuna to 1,025, on volume of 10,517 shares.
